title: Vasiliy's Multiset
statementMd:
Author has gone out of the stories about Vasiliy, so here is just a formal task description.

You are given $*q*$ queries and a multiset $*A*$, initially containing only integer $0$. There are three types of queries:

1. "`+ x`" — add integer $*x*$ to multiset $*A*$.
2. "`- x`" — erase one occurrence of integer $*x*$ from multiset $*A*$. It's guaranteed that at least one $*x*$ is present in the multiset $*A*$ before this query.
3. "`? x`" — you are given integer $*x*$ and need to compute the value ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8f2e13983d6f05b3e4b5b3f51e3fa786849dc1b.png), i.e. the maximum value of bitwise exclusive OR (also know as XOR) of integer $*x*$ and some integer $*y*$ from the multiset $*A*$.

Multiset is a set, where equal elements are allowed.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 200 000$) — the number of queries Vasiliy has to perform.

Each of the following $*q*$ lines of the input contains one of three characters '`+`', '`-`' or '`?`' and an integer $*x*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *x*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$). It's guaranteed that there is at least one query of the third type.

Note, that the integer $0$ will always be present in the set $*A*$.

## Output

For each query of the type '`?`' print one integer — the maximum value of bitwise exclusive OR (XOR) of integer $*x*_{*i*}$ and some integer from the multiset $*A*$.

## Note

After first five operations multiset $*A*$ contains integers $0$, $8$, $9$, $11$, $6$ and $1$.

The answer for the sixth query is integer ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e2f3d4f1a7c134a5695ba1d548df2b4f9292206.png) — maximum among integers ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6cb1b5a0f9bbad177b1de700e918187c8fb3e972.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7644536d2010111824755b5dd2b6043340b2bf4d.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a437d1611f6c2ae5cd9a275a6ab2df61296988e.png), ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4e3eeab99fa495ecdcd103c68de47dd72943016f.png) and ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/97b73b0f3e59862ed9f80fa83527d97e0ed0a084.png).
statementZhMd:
作者已经不再讲述 Vasiliy 的故事了，因此这里只给出形式化的题目描述。

给定 $*q*$ 次查询和一个多重集合 $*A*$，其初始时只包含整数 $0$。查询有以下三种类型：

1. "`+ x`" — 向多重集合 $*A*$ 中加入整数 $*x*$。
2. "`- x`" — 从多重集合 $*A*$ 中删除一个整数 $*x*$。保证在执行此查询前，多重集合 $*A*$ 中至少存在一个 $*x*$。
3. "`? x`" — 给定整数 $*x*$，需要计算 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e8f2e13983d6f05b3e4b5b3f51e3fa786849dc1b.png) 的值，即整数 $*x*$ 与多重集合 $*A*$ 中某个整数 $*y*$ 进行按位异或（也称 XOR）所得结果的最大值。

多重集合是一种允许包含相同元素的集合。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 200 000$），表示 Vasiliy 需要执行的查询次数。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中，每行包含三个字符 '`+`'、'`-`' 或 '`?`' 中的一个，以及一个整数 $*x*_{*i}$（$1 ≤ *x*_{*i}$ ≤ 10^{9}$）。保证至少存在一次第三种类型的查询。

注意，整数 $0$ 始终存在于集合 $*A*$ 中。

## 输出格式

对于每个类型为 '`?`' 的查询，输出一个整数，即整数 $*x*_{*i}$ 与多重集合 $*A*$ 中某个整数进行按位异或（XOR）所得结果的最大值。

## 说明

执行前五次操作后，多重集合 $*A*$ 包含整数 $0$、$8$、$9$、$11$、$6$ 和 $1$。

第六次查询的答案是整数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9e2f3d4f1a7c134a5695ba1d548df2b4f9292206.png)，它是整数 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6cb1b5a0f9bbad177b1de700e918187c8fb3e972.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7644536d2010111824755b5dd2b6043340b2bf4d.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/9a437d1611f6c2ae5cd9a275a6ab2df61296988e.png)、![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4e3eeab99fa495ecdcd103c68de47dd72943016f.png) 和 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/97b73b0f3e59862ed9f80fa83527d97e0ed0a084.png) 中的最大值。
